justification: Evidence-backed categorical gate. Castle Table 2 (PDF p8) defines alley cropping on annual cropland or forage grown between tree rows without grazing, excluding existing tree crops. WorldCover 40 maps annual cropland. WorldCover 30 is conditional on a verified managed-forage/non-grazing mask; it is not treated as pasture proof. Built-up, permanent snow/ice and permanent water cannot satisfy this host definition. Tree/shrub cover remains unknown because those classes mix farms and non-farms.

Evidence-backed categorical gate. WOCAT 507 describes restoring degraded wasteland and improving depleted farmland (Kenya example, PDF p1). Within the regeneration-on-farmland family, WorldCover alone cannot identify degradation or farmland history. Positive classes require observed depleted/degraded farmland masks; bare soil alone is never evidence of restoration potential. This gate establishes land-use compatibility, not regeneration success or rootstock presence. Tree cover remains unresolved. Pete input review 2026-10-20: depletion/degradation are targeting context; non-cropland requires farmland identity.

Candidate applicability gate for windbreaks/shelterbelts only. Castle Table 2 PDF p8 places windbreaks on delineated cropland/pasture field boundaries in the US Midwest. WorldCover cropland requires independently mapped field-boundary placement; grassland additionally requires managed pasture confirmation. No universal buffer width or contour-siting rule is inferred. Report applicability zones and candidate line length, never eligible pixel area as planting footprint. Source and cross-context mapping remain pending review. Pete Steward approved B1 on 2026-10-20: boundary geometry required; buffer width varies by publications and regions. Field delineation may be less available in African extensive systems; missing geometry remains unknown. Pete input review 2026-10-20: field boundaries required for both cropland and pasture; no separate pasture-management gate.
